title: Search for planning information about a property
summary: Search for planning information about a property online using the NSW Planning Portal's Spatial Viewer.
intro:
If you'd like to search for planning information about a property, you can do this online via the NSW Planning Portal's Spatial Viewer.

The Spatial Viewer is a digital mapping service that provides easy-to-use, information-rich maps for every address and lot in NSW.
what_you_need: The address of the property you wish to search.

how_to_steps.text: Enter the address, lot, or local government area you'd like to investigate.
